title: PsMyBackup Snapshot Manifest
description: Schema for backup-manifest.json generated by PsMyBackup.

format.description: Identifies this JSON document as a PsMyBackup snapshot manifest.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the Backup Manifest Document Schema.

snapshotId.description: Unique snapshot ID in canonical GUID format (D).

entries.description: Files successfully copied into the snapshot, with optional SHA-256 hashes.

path.description: File path relative to the snapshot directory, using forward slashes and starting with the source name.

size.description: Size of the copied file in bytes.

lastWriteTimeUtc.description: Original file modification time in UTC, in RFC 3339-compatible format.

sha256.description: Uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the copied file, or null if manifest hashing is disabled.
